build_zeroshot_classifier: build a zero-shot classifier by encoding class names through the model's text encoder and normalizing embeddings
run_zeroshot_eval: run zero-shot evaluation on ImageNet or ADE20K datasets using a prebuilt classifier and dataloader
compute_accuracy_topk: compute top-k accuracy scores by comparing model output logits against ground truth targets
run_inference_loop: run the inference loop over a dataloader to encode images, compute logits, and measure top1 and top5 accuracy
review_zero_shot_eval: review the zero_shot_eval function that orchestrates classifier building and evaluation across ImageNet-val, ImageNet-v2, and ADE20K datasets
